worth_a_look.rationale: Changes the guard from a boolean check to an identity comparison. This is a narrower check; an accidental edit that changes `get_visible()` to return a truthy non-boolean value (or removes the `not`) would bypass the protection.

worth_a_look.label: untested_invariant
worth_a_look.explanation: The mutant replaces `not self.get_visible()` with `self.get_visible() is False`, making the early return happen only when get_visible() is exactly False. If get_visible() ever returns another falsy value (e.g., 0, None), the mutant would draw when the original would skip, changing observable behavior. The existing tests all use proper boolean visibility, so they do not catch this difference.
